query: MATCH (m:Meeting) OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m) WITH m,count(DISTINCT r) AS total OPTIONAL MATCH (r2:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m), (r2)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(:Company {companyName:'Huawei'}) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meetingNumber,m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt,count(DISTINCT r2) AS huaweiCount,total,CASE WHEN total=0 THEN null ELSE round(100.0*count(DISTINCT r2)/total,1) END AS ratio ORDER BY meetingNumberInt ASC,meetingNumber ASC
